北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友们，气温 -4℃，体感很冷，注意防寒保暖，多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's -4℃ and feels colder. Stay warm and hydrate!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感 -4℃，北风呼呼，出门记得多穿，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like -4℃ with north wind. Bundle up to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海气温 2℃，体感 -3℃ 喔，添衣保暖，别感冒啦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is 2℃ but feels like -3℃. Add more layers and don't catch a cold!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温 10℃ 左右，体感微凉，出门带把伞吧。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, around 10℃. It feels cool, bring an umbrella.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳气温 13℃，阴天微风，注意保暖，出门注意安全。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is 13℃, overcast with light wind. Stay warm and be safe out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 -4℃，北风不小，出门穿厚点，当心着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like -4℃ with a strong north wind. Dress warmly and beware of the cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 -7℃，寒意十足，多穿点，注意防寒保暖！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like -7℃, very cold. Dress warmly and stay protected from the cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 2℃，湿冷感强，别忘了多加衣哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 2℃, damp and cold. Don't forget to add layers!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 -6℃，湿冷刺骨，出门一定要穿暖和，注意身体！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like -6℃, damp and bone-chilling. Dress very warmly and take care!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 -3℃，天气干燥，记得多喝水，注意皮肤保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like -3℃, very dry. Remember to hydrate and moisturize your skin.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度 86%，体感 2℃，注意防潮保暖哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, 86% humidity, feels like 2℃. Mind the dampness and stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 -21℃，体感 -26℃，极致严寒，务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -21℃, feels like -26℃. Extreme cold, please bundle up thoroughly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -21℃，天寒地冻，全套保暖装备不能少！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -21℃, freezing cold. All your warm gear is a must!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -21℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，气温 17℃，体感舒适，户外活动很棒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and 17℃, feels comfortable. Great for outdoor activities!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门气温 11℃，体感 6℃，微凉，记得添件薄外套。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is 11℃, feels like 6℃, a bit chilly. Remember a light jacket.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 -13℃，风力 5级，风寒效应强，全副武装！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -13℃ with strong wind. High wind chill, bundle up completely!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -14℃，天气寒冷，注意防寒，别冻着了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -14℃, very cold. Be sure to stay warm and avoid frostbite.
